facts.fact: LISGIS and the Liberia Telecommunications Authority signed an MoU making the LTA a primary administrative data source for telecoms and ICT statistics, including operator revenue and expenditure, for periodic and annual reports.
The MoU names the Liberia Telecommunications Authority's records as the administrative source.

LBR.note: Censuses and surveys are named only as inputs; no census or survey stated.
Digital skills are named only as a statistic LISGIS will compile; no programme or measured share.
No school internet figure or curriculum statement.
